changeSet.author: osmontero
changeSet.comment: Reserve utm_dashboard_visualization ids >= 1000000 for user rows; renumber existing user rows off the system range (#3056).
changeSet.sql:
-- The CTEs (base, targets) are fully evaluated BEFORE the -- data-modifying UPDATE, freezing max(id) and the row set. -- Each user row in the low range is renumbered to a fresh id -- in the reserved >= 1000000 range, in original-id order, so -- the new ids are distinct, above every existing id (no -- collision), and all >= 1000000 in one pass. Re-running the -- changeset finds no user rows left in the low range and is a -- no-op. WITH base AS ( SELECT GREATEST(1000000, COALESCE((SELECT max(id) FROM utm_dashboard_visualization), 999999) + 1) AS b ), targets AS ( SELECT id AS old_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) AS i FROM utm_dashboard_visualization WHERE id_dashboard >= 1000000 AND id < 1000000 ) UPDATE utm_dashboard_visualization AS dv SET id = base.b + targets.i - 1 FROM targets, base WHERE dv.id = targets.old_id;
SELECT setval('utm_dashboard_visualization_id_seq', GREATEST(1000000, COALESCE((SELECT max(id) FROM utm_dashboard_visualization), 999999)), false);
